data.body: Confirmed design decision (2026-09-03)\n\nV1 will not use tfparse evaluation. The guaranteed backend is side-effect-free structural analysis of the complete affected module/local impact closure: declarations, references, module/provider sources, source spans, and literal values only. Any computed attribute value returns abstain. Authoritative locally available tools such as terraform-config-inspect, TFLint, or Trivy may corroborate a narrowly matching query under Rebar-owned safe configuration; they do not originate findings, and a clean/absent diagnostic never proves correctness. Semantic evaluation is deferred until an upstream no-I/O mode or a portable strong sandbox exists.
